set.body:
Outcome

Perform the atomic public cutover: one mvpa artifact and vocabulary, no compatibility namespace, and no old modules or ontology.

Acceptance

- mvpa-fit, mvpa-dataset, and mvpa-spatial are removed.
- Legacy source, tests, examples, and live documentation are gone.
- The cruft court is empty.
- This gate closes only after every Phase 6 child closes.
set.title: P6: consolidate one mvpa module and delete the legacy ontology
